youtube.title: One line, two moods: the same shots rendered as "type": "kids" and "type": "beauty"
youtube.description:
One line, two moods: the same two shots and the same words, rendered twice. The only change is "type": "kids" or "type": "beauty", this week's new presets.
Kids: rounded Fredoka captions, cuts that snap to the beat. Beauty: no beat snap, music at -16 dB. This 23 s Short rendered in 54 s on a 4-core CPU, no GPU; the text audit checked all 7 on-screen strings, exact.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
